items.raw_excerpt: There is a particular problem with writing about Portugal’s hidden places. The moment you tell everyone where they are, they aren’t quite so hidden anymore.
items.summary_en: Sharing Portugal's hidden spots comes with a risk. Once you reveal their location, they may lose their secluded charm. These secret places deserve to stay protected to preserve their magic.
items.summary_ko: 포르투갈의 숨겨진 장소를 소개할 때 한 가지 문제가 있습니다. 위치를 공개하면 더 이상 숨겨지지 않기 때문입니다. 이 비밀스러운 장소들의 매력을 지키기 위해 보호하는 것이 중요합니다.

items.raw_excerpt: Local tribals oppose Gondwana University’s appointment of ex-Maoist Bhupati as coordinator, demanding empowerment for deserving tribal candidates.
items.summary_en: Local tribal groups in Maharashtra oppose the appointment of an ex-Maoist as coordinator at Gondwana University. They say deserving tribal candidates should get such roles instead.

items.summary_en: A new free app called BiteWatch lets people scan food barcodes to see simple nutrition facts. The app shows sugar, salt, and fat levels in easy-to-read formats. It was developed under the EU Preventia project and is available across Europe.
items.summary_ko: BiteWatch라는 무료 앱이 출시되어 식품 바코드를 스캔하면 쉽게 영양 성분을 확인할 수 있다. 설탕, 소금, 지방 함량을 일일 권장량 대비 보기 좋게 보여준다. EU Preventia 사업으로 개발되어 유럽 전역에서 무료로 이용할 수 있다.
items.title_en: Free EU App BiteWatch Helps Consumers Check Food Nutrition

items.raw_excerpt: Médica diz que boa parte do que seria popularmente considerado mau comportamento de crianças com TEA, na realidade reflete confusão ou sobrecarga, não necessariamente oposição.
items.summary_en: A doctor explains that much of what people think is bad behavior in children with autism is actually confusion or overload. The article lists simple strategies that can help families and doctors better support autistic children during appointments and daily life.
items.summary_ko: 의사가 자폐증 아이의 문제 행동처럼 보이는 것이 사실은 혼란이나 과부하라고 설명한다. 가족과 의사가 자폐증 아이를 더 잘 돌볼 수 있는 간단한 전략을 공유한다.
items.title_en: Doctor Shares Tips to Help Children with Autism

items.raw_excerpt: SA greyhound trainer Jack Clayton Trengove has been found "entirely unfit" to participate in the industry, with the state's governing body issuing him with a lifetime disqualification and a $5,000 fine.
items.summary_en: South Australia greyhound trainer Jack Clayton Trengove was found unfit to participate in the industry. The state governing body issued him a lifetime disqualification and a $5,000 fine for undisclosed fractures to dogs.

items.raw_excerpt: Javiera Horta, directora de Educación de Fundación Kiri, abordó en Cooperativa mediciones sobre bienestar entre el alumnado.
items.summary_en: Javiera Horta from Fundación Kiri talked about how skateboarding, robotics and theater help school children grow emotionally. A new survey measured students' well-being. These fun activities made children feel happier at school.

items.title_en: Skate, robotics and theater help kids grow emotionally

items.raw_excerpt: A call for the development of a local museum in every county in Ireland.
